title: Principle-to-Feature Traceability
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting principle-to-feature traceability to a traceability matrix that maps one controlling principle to one feature with its processing demand named, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Map one controlling principle to one feature, with the processing demand named explicitly.
Detect post-hoc justification (many principles attached to one cosmetic change).
Describe features as mechanisms that act on a demand, not as decoration.
Defend any feature by tracing it forward from principle to demand to implementation.
